info.title: hydromart-digital notifications raised by machine accounts
info.description:
AI-5, AI-9, AI-7c, HD-18, HD-15. Routes n8n calls, with a machine token, to raise a notification in hydromart-digital's own staff notifications: a row in the staff feed (the bell on the console) and a push to the phones of the accounts it is for. hydromart-digital writes the text itself (Indonesian, the product default); the caller sends facts, never copy.

Authentication: a machine token from POST /auth/api/v1/auth/machine/token (auth.openapi.json): ES256, aud hydromart-machine, 15 minutes. Each route names the capability its token's scopes must include. An AI-web token (aud hydromart-ai) is refused on these routes, whoever the person is, and so is any hydromart-digital session token whose role does not hold that capability.

Audit trail: every call is recorded in hydromart-digital's audit trail BEFORE it runs, as the machine account, with the request body, and refused with 503 when it cannot be recorded; nothing is notified then. Send X-Workflow to name the n8n workflow in that record.

Rate limit: counted per machine account (the token's sub), at the edge and again in the service; a 429 carries Retry-After.

Compatibility: unknown request fields are refused (400), so send only the fields listed. A field may be added to a response within version 1; removing or renaming one is a new contract version.

post.summary: Tell the people who review franchise applications that a calon mitra applied on /waralaba.
post.description:
Called by n8n for each verified franchise.application_submitted event (events.openapi.json), with that event's eventId and data. The token's scopes must include franchiseApplicationNotify.

Who is told: every account whose role holds the franchiseApplications capability (head office and the director by default; another role, Sales for one, once HQ gives it that capability at /hq/access). They see a row titled Lamaran waralaba baru in their staff notifications, get a push unless they switched off the push of the Lamaran waralaba baru switch on their profile (/hq/profile), and get an email (subject Lamaran waralaba baru: calon mitra di <city>, <province>; plain text; the place and the link, nothing else) unless they switched off its email (on by default) or their login has no email address. hydromart sends the email itself; n8n holds no email credential. The row is shown either way. The row is the record and the push and the email are best effort: one that fails (the account directory unreachable at that moment, a device or a mail server that refuses it) is not sent again, by a retry or a replay of the same eventId either. The row, the push and the email open the application, /hq/applications/detail?id=<applicationId>. A superuser account sees the row but is neither pushed nor emailed. Nobody else sees it.

Idempotent on eventId: a repeated eventId (a retry after a timeout, a replay of the event, in any letter case) answers 200 with the id of the notification the first call made, and nobody is notified twice. The first call's city and province are the ones shown.

city and province are shown as one line of plain text: control characters and runs of whitespace (newlines, tabs) become one space, invisible format characters (zero-width, bidirectional) are dropped, and the ends are trimmed. A value with nothing visible left, or with characters a place name does not use, is refused with 400 (see the pattern).

parameters.name: X-Workflow
parameters.description: The n8n workflow making the call, recorded in the audit trail as workflow (trimmed, at most 120 characters). Not checked.

200.description: The notification exists: made by this call, or by an earlier call with the same eventId.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: a field missing, malformed or unknown; eventId that is not franchise.application_submitted:<applicationId> of the same request; city or province empty, longer than 100 characters, with nothing visible left, or not a place name (letters, spaces and . , ' ( ) - only: no digits, no @ : / < >, and no full stop before two letters, so no web address). Not worth retrying with the same body.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many calls from this machine account. Wait the seconds in Retry-After, then retry with the same body.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: the audit trail could not record the call, so nothing was notified. Retry later with the same body; the eventId keeps a retry from notifying twice.

post.summary: Trigger the Direksi's morning summary: each recipient is told what waits for their own decision.
post.description:
Called by n8n on its morning schedule, with the date of the day. The token's scopes must include morningSummaryNotify. n8n only TRIGGERS: it sends a date and receives counts of notifications, never a number of approvals. hydromart-digital picks the recipients, computes what waits for each one, writes the text and sends it; nothing about the queues passes through n8n.

Who is told: every active account whose role is DIREKTUR (the recipient roles are one constant in hydromart-digital, MORNING_SUMMARY_ROLES). For each, hydromart-digital asks dashboard-service for that person's own approval queues: the same answer, with the same rules, as GET /dashboard/api/v1/dashboard/pending-approvals (approvals.openapi.json) gives that person, so the counts are items waiting for THIS person's decision. They get one notification, e.g. 'Persetujuan yang menunggu Anda: Usulan harga 2, Cuti 1. Tertua sejak 20 Nov.': counts and queue names only, nothing personal. A queue that could not be read is said as 'belum terbaca', never as 0. A person none of whose readable queues has anything waiting while some queue could not be read gets no row yet and counts as failed (503): there is nothing real to say, and a half summary would block the complete one on the retry. A person with nothing waiting gets nothing at all (no row, no push, no email). Tapping it opens the screen of the queue with the most waiting.

Channels (owner rule 24 Nov 2026, every staff notification n8n raises): the bell in the staff notifications, a push, and an email (plain text, subject 'Persetujuan yang menunggu Anda pagi ini'; hydromart sends it, n8n holds no email credential). Each recipient can switch the push and the email off on their profile (/hq/profile, 'Ringkasan persetujuan pagi'); both are on by default. WhatsApp is not sent yet: it waits for the Meta channel, and the response says whatsapp 'pending', never 'sent'.

eventId is morning-summary:<date> and date is TODAY in Asia/Jakarta (WIB, UTC+7), as YYYY-MM-DD; any other day is refused with 400, so a replay of an old trigger cannot send today's counts under yesterday's name. Idempotent per recipient: a person who already has the day's notification is not sent it again, so a retry or a replay of the same eventId answers 200 and sends nobody twice. A retry after a 503 completes the recipients that were not reached; the others keep the first send's counts. A rerun must happen the same WIB day: after midnight WIB the date is no longer today and is refused with 400, so the unfinished recipients get nothing for that day.

Schedule it once a day, in the morning WIB, with eventId morning-summary:<that day's WIB date>. 200 means every recipient has the day's summary or had nothing waiting; on 503 retry the same body later.

post.summary: Tell the people who can grant AI web access that someone asked for it.
post.description:
Called by n8n when someone presses 'Minta akses' in the AI web, after the AI web has recorded the request. The token's scopes must include aiAccessRequestNotify. n8n carries ids only: the event id, the account that asked, and what it asked for (legal entity ids and/or a data group). hydromart-digital looks up who the requester is (their name and role) and the legal entities' names, writes the text itself (Indonesian) and sends it; no name or sentence passes through n8n.

Who is told: every active account whose role holds the legalEntityAiAccess capability (SUPER_ADMIN by default; the same people who save the AI access matrix on /hq/legal-entities). Each gets one notification, e.g. 'Budi Santoso (HEAD OFFICE) meminta akses AI web untuk Indowater. Buka Badan hukum, bagian akses AI, untuk memberikannya.' When no legal entity is named the data group is said instead ('data keuangan'); a requester with no name on file is 'Seorang staf'. Tapping it opens /hq/legal-entities, where the AI access matrix is.

Channels (owner rule 24 Nov 2026, every staff notification n8n raises): the bell in the staff notifications, a push, and an email (plain text; hydromart sends it, n8n holds no email credential). Each recipient can switch the push and the email off on their profile (/hq/profile, 'Permintaan akses AI web'); both are on by default. WhatsApp is not sent yet: it waits for the Meta channel, and the response says whatsapp 'pending', never 'sent'.

A requester who does not exist, or who can already grant AI access, answers 200 with recipients 0 and notified 0: nothing is sent and nothing says who exists. Rate cap, inside hydromart-digital: at most 3 distinct eventIds per requesterAccountId and 30 overall in any rolling hour. Past it the answer is still 200, with capped true and notified 0 (nothing is sent, a warning is logged): it is not worth retrying. A retry of an eventId already filed is never counted as new. Requests for an unknown or already-capable requester are not counted.

Idempotent per recipient on eventId: a retry or a replay answers 200 and sends nobody twice. A retry after a 503 completes the recipients that were not reached.

post.summary: Trigger one kind of customer reminder: subscription tomorrow, points about to expire, unpaid order.
post.description:
Called by n8n on its schedule (HD-18), with the kind and the date of the day. The token's scopes must include customerReminderNotify. n8n only TRIGGERS: it sends a kind and a date and receives counts, never a customer, an order or a number of points. hydromart-digital asks the service that owns the data who is due, writes the text (Indonesian, or the customer's own language) and files one notification per customer per thing.

Kinds. SUBSCRIPTION_TOMORROW: every ACTIVE subscription whose next delivery falls tomorrow in Asia/Jakarta; one reminder per subscription per delivery day. POINTS_EXPIRING: every loyalty EARN lot that expires within the next 7 days and has not expired yet (what the customer stands to lose is capped at their balance); one reminder per lot, ever; none while the point-expiry sweep is switched off, because nothing then expires. UNPAID_ORDER: transfer and QRIS orders still waiting for their payment once they are two thirds of the way to the auto-cancel (40 of the default 60 minutes; the window follows the cancel setting and never reaches an order the sweep could already cancel); one reminder per order. Counter sales, subscription deliveries and orders booked for a later slot are never reminded (the sweep never cancels them either). The window is a third of the cancel setting wide (20 minutes by default): call this at most every 10 minutes.

Channels: the customer's in-app inbox (the bell) and a push to their devices, through the same path as every customer notification, so a customer who switched push off gets the inbox row only. WhatsApp is not sent: it waits for per-number consent (HD-13), and the response says whatsapp 'pending', never 'sent'.

date is TODAY in Asia/Jakarta (WIB, UTC+7), as YYYY-MM-DD; any other day is refused with 400, so a replay of an old trigger cannot remind about today's state under yesterday's name. Idempotent: a customer who already has a given reminder is not sent it again, so a retry, a second tick or an overlapping run answers 200 with the repeats counted as skipped, and sends nothing twice.

Recommended schedule (WIB): SUBSCRIPTION_TOMORROW once a day at 17.00; POINTS_EXPIRING once a day at 10.00; UNPAID_ORDER every 10 minutes. 200 means everyone due has the reminder; on 503 retry the same body later.

post.summary: Tell who must know that depot equipment maintenance is due.
post.description:
Called by n8n once a day (recommended 07:30 WIB) to run the maintenance sweep. The token's scopes must include maintenanceDueNotify. n8n only says 'now' and sends today's WIB date; which items are due, who is told and the words are hydromart-digital's, and no count or sentence passes through n8n.

What is due: a piece of depot equipment (filter, UV lamp, RO membrane...) is due when EITHER the days since its last service reach its day limit OR the water through the depot's meter since its last service reaches its volume limit (m3), whichever comes first. The volume is the sum of closing minus opening of the depot's daily meter readings over the complete WIB days after the service day up to yesterday; a day without a closed reading adds nothing, so the figure is a floor. An item whose meter cannot be read is not called due by volume.

Who is told: the depot's Kepala depot, the supervisors over the depot (its assistant supervisor and everyone above them in the reporting line) and HQ Operasional (every head-office account, all depots). The depot's Kepala and supervisors get one notification per depot listing its due items, e.g. 'Perawatan jatuh tempo di Cikini: Membran RO (volume air sudah 520,3 m3 dari batas 500 m3). Buka menu Perawatan untuk menjadwalkan servis.'; HQ gets ONE notification per run with the due count per depot ('Perawatan jatuh tempo di 5 depot: 12 item: Cikini 4, ...'). A depot digest names up to 5 items and 'dan N lainnya'; tapping it opens that depot's maintenance screen, which lists them all. HQ is told again as soon as an item it has not heard of is due, and every HEAD_OFFICE account gets only the HQ row, not a depot row on top.

Channels (owner rule 24 Nov 2026): the bell, a push and an email (plain text; hydromart sends it, n8n holds no email credential; the email reaches staff who can open the HQ console). Each recipient can switch the push and the email off on their profile (/hq/profile, 'Perawatan alat jatuh tempo'); both are on by default. WhatsApp is not sent yet: it waits for the Meta channel, and the response says whatsapp 'pending', never 'sent'.

Not a daily nag: each person is told about an item the first day it is found due for them, then again every 3 days while it stays due; a person who was not reached, or who is new in the role, is told on the next run (remindLater counts the items nobody needed telling about). The first run after release tells about every item already due, as one digest per recipient. Marking it serviced starts a new cycle. `date` must be today in Asia/Jakarta (400 otherwise), so a replay of an old trigger cannot go out under today's name. A retry the same WIB day sends nobody twice: it completes the recipients that were not reached.

post.summary: Tell the people who read a legal entity's calon mitra reports that its weekly Sales report is ready.
post.description:
Called by n8n on Monday morning (07:00 WIB) with the Monday of the week that just ended and the legal entities reported. The token's scopes must include salesReportNotify. n8n only TRIGGERS and carries ids: no number, no text, no recipient. The numbers live in the AI web and are shown there after sign-in; hydromart-digital writes the notice itself and links to the report page.

Who is told, per legal entity: every ACTIVE staff account whose role is MARKETING or DIREKTUR, or whose role (built-in or custom, e.g. Sales Lead) holds prospectSettings, AND whose role is granted that legal entity in the AI web (legal_entity_ai_grants). SUPER_ADMIN is not told. An id that is not a legal entity is skipped and counted in unknownEntities.

Notice: event SALES_WEEKLY_REPORT, title 'Laporan Sales mingguan siap', text 'Minggu <d MMM> - <d MMM>: buka laporan calon mitra untuk <legal entity name>.' Channels (owner rule 24 Nov 2026): bell, push and an email (HR email first, else the login email; the email carries the link <AI web>/calon-mitra/laporan?minggu=<weekStart>&be=<legalEntityId>). Each recipient can switch push and email off on /hq/profile ('Laporan Sales mingguan siap'). WhatsApp is not sent yet: the response says whatsapp 'pending', never 'sent'.

eventId is sales-weekly:<weekStart>. weekStart must be a Monday and the week that just ended: accepted from the next Monday until that week's own Sunday (Asia/Jakarta), so a late retry works; any other week is refused with 400. Idempotent per (eventId, legal entity, recipient): a retry or replay sends nobody twice. 503 means a read or a recipient failed (or AI_WEB_URL is not configured): retry the same body.

An entity that is switched off is skipped and counted in inactiveEntities. The route works through the entities one after another (at most 50): allow a long HTTP timeout (for example 120 seconds). A retry after a timeout is safe, because nothing is sent twice.

post.summary: Tell the people who run the AI team that an agent flagged something, reached its cap or was stopped.
post.description:
Called by n8n when the AI web raises an agent event. The token's scopes must include aiAgentNotify. n8n carries ids and a kind only: no number, no free text. hydromart-digital writes the words (event AI_AGENT_FLAG, AI_AGENT_CAP or AI_AGENT_STOPPED; STOPPED_ALL says 'Semua agen AI dihentikan') and the link <AI web>/tim-ai/<agentId> (<AI web>/tim-ai for STOPPED_ALL).

Who is told: every active account whose role holds aiTeamManage (Direksi and SUPER_ADMIN), plus the active accounts of bossRole when that role holds aiTeamRead; no depot staff. Channels: bell, push and email (HR email first, else login email); each person can switch push and email off on /hq/profile ('Pemberitahuan agen AI'). WhatsApp is not sent yet: the response says whatsapp 'pending', never 'sent'. There is no depotId field: a body carrying one is refused with 403 by the depot-scope guard.

503 means the recipients could not be read or filed, or AI_WEB_URL is not configured: retry the same body.

Idempotent per (kind, agentId, eventId, recipient): reusing an eventId for another kind or agent is a new notice. A bossRole that is not a role holding aiTeamRead is refused with 400 and code BOSS_ROLE_UNKNOWN, so a wrong key is learned, not silently ignored.

post.summary: Tell who must know that a depot permit or lab test is due.
post.description:
Called by n8n once a day (recommended 07:30 WIB) to run the permit and lab-test sweep. The token's scopes must include complianceDueNotify. n8n only says 'now' and sends today's WIB date; what is due, who is told and the words are hydromart-digital's.

What is due: a permit (e.g. SLHS) from 30 days before its valid-until day, and after it expires (a renewed permit of the same kind replaces the old one); a required lab test when the days since the last test of its kind pass its interval (physical and microbiology 30 days, E. coli 90 days, chemistry 180 days; a full-panel test counts for all three; a depot never tested counts from the day it was added). The intervals are code constants until Dinkes answers.

Who is told, channels, de-duplication (first day found due, then every 3 days while it stays due) and the whatsapp 'pending' rule are the same as maintenance-due. Permit and lab-test reminders are separate notifications (kinds PERMIT_DUE and LAB_TEST_DUE) under the same profile switch as maintenance. They are never held back by a quality hold: they are how one ends.

post.summary: Tell staff that a depot quality hold started or ended.
post.description:
Called by n8n when it receives the signed event depot.quality_hold_changed. The token's scopes must include qualityHoldNotify. n8n relays the event's three fields; hydromart-digital trusts only the depot id: it reads the depot's CURRENT hold state again and tells staff only when the event agrees with it (ACTIVE while the depot is on hold, ENDED while it is not). Otherwise the answer is 200 with notified 0 and stale true: do not retry.

Told (staff only, never customers): the depot's Kepala, the supervisors over it, HQ Operasional and Marketing (network-wide), each once, by bell, push and email. The words are hydromart-digital's and carry the depot name and the WIB time, never the reason or lab detail. A re-delivered event files nothing twice (the key is the depot, status, changedAt and recipient).

The depot id is named holdDepotId here, not depotId: a body key named depotId is read by the depot-scope guard, which refuses a machine token with 403.

parameters.description: The n8n workflow making the call, recorded in the audit trail as workflow (trimmed, at most 120 characters). Not checked.

200.description: Staff were told (or already had been: a re-delivered event), or the event is stale and nobody was.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: holdDepotId not a UUID, status not ACTIVE or ENDED, changedAt not an ISO-8601 time, or an unknown field. Not worth retrying with the same body.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: no token, an expired one, or one hydromart-digital cannot verify. That includes every token after AI and machine access was switched off (the published key set is empty): POST /auth/api/v1/auth/machine/token then answers 503. Get a new token, then retry.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: a valid token that may not call this: an AI-web token, or a machine token whose scopes do not include qualityHoldNotify. Not worth retrying until the machine account's scopes change.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many calls from this machine account. Wait the seconds in Retry-After, then retry with the same body.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: the audit trail could not record the call (nothing was sent), or the depot directory or the recipients could not be read, or a recipient could not be filed. Retry the same body: rows already filed stay, and nobody is told twice.

machineToken.description: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> from POST /auth/api/v1/auth/machine/token. ES256, aud hydromart-machine; its scopes claim is the machine account's closed capability list.

eventId.description: The event's eventId, unchanged: franchise.application_submitted:<applicationId>. Letter case is ignored. The dedupe key.

applicationId.description: The event's data.applicationId. Must be the id inside eventId.

city.description: The event's data.city, unchanged (hydromart-digital cleans it, see the route description).

code.description: VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, RATE_LIMITED or SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.
